description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner (Recommendation Systems) based in Luxembourg. As a Product Owner, you will own the post-purchase customer experience, with a strong focus on activation, matching, relevance, and personalized recommendations. Your mission will be to help paying customers reach meaningful value as quickly as possible by improving how they discover and connect with relevant opportunities. You’ll work across product discovery, recommendation systems, segmentation, personalization, and experimentation. Using data, research, and product intuition, you’ll identify bottlenecks and turn them into measurable product opportunities. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering, design, analytics, and data/ML teams to turn hypotheses into impactful product improvements. This is an end-to-end ownership role in a remote, international, and fast-moving product environment. Accountabilities Own the post-purchase customer journey, focusing on activation, matching, relevance, and the speed at which paying customers reach meaningful value. Optimize offer volume and recommendation quality so customers receive a relevant selection without being overwhelmed or underserved. Improve the relevance and trustworthiness of recommendations and increase the number of relevant invitations reaching paying customers. Increase the likelihood that new customers achieve a quality match during their first week. Design and improve engagement mechanics such as gamification, nudges, reminders, and conversation reactivation features. Analyze matching parameters across user segments and apply segmentation, personalization, and data enrichment to improve recommendation outcomes. Identify bottlenecks and growth opportunities across the post-purchase journey using quantitative data, qualitative research, and product insight. Translate product opportunities into clear, testable hypotheses with defined success metrics and measurable outcomes. Partner with engineers, designers, analysts, and data/ML specialists to prioritize, develop, test, and launch product improvements. Manage product requirements, priorities, and delivery timelines to ensure efficient and predictable execution. Run A/B tests and other product experiments, analyze results and metrics, and iterate or scale solutions based on evidence. Take end-to-end ownership of product outcomes, focusing on measurable impact rather than process for its own sake. Requirements Hands-on B2C product experience, particularly in customer experience, customer journey design, activation, onboarding, or first-session experiences. Experience working with discovery-driven products involving large volumes of offers, listings, or potential matches. Practical understanding of search and feed relevance, matching systems, recommendation engines, personalization, or related product experiences. Experience with segmentation, personalization, and enriching offers or listings with additional data. Relevant experience in marketplaces, aggregators, dating or social discovery, real estate, classifieds, e-commerce with large catalogs, or other discovery- and recommendation-driven products. Strong ability to formulate product hypotheses, define clear requirements, and establish measurable success criteria. Proven ability to drive product delivery from idea through implementation and evaluation. Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and other product experiments. Comfortable combining qualitative and quantitative research to understand customer behavior and validate product decisions. Strong understanding of product metrics and the ability to identify meaningful growth opportunities from data. Effective cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with designers, analysts, engineers, and data/ML specialists. Results-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and willingness to make decisions independently. Comfortable working with changing priorities and ambiguity in a fast-paced product environment. Clear, direct communication skills and a willingness to treat failures and experiments as opportunities for learning. Benefits Fully remote, full-time opportunity. Initial compensation level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process before employment begins. 28 calendar days of vacation per year. 7 additional wellness days annually for personal, household, or recovery needs. Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations. 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and professional events. Corporate discounts for English language lessons. Health benefits, including up to $1,000 gross per year toward self-purchased health insurance or eligible medical expenses when corporate medical insurance is not available. Workplace equipment and setup support, including reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross once every three years for eligible home-office or coworking expenses outside company-provided locations. Internal gamified recognition program with rewards that can be exchanged for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other perks. Opportunity to work within a globally distributed, remote-first environment with an international team. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description: About Us Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar. Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services. We have six Customer Service Centres for Trip.com, established in Japan, Korea, the UK, Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 35 different languages. We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 50 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspires to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller. We are looking for a commercially driven and strategic Marketplace Growth Manager to own the business performance of Trip.com's Attractions & Tours business across key ANT Europe Locales, particularly GB, Italy, Spain, and France. This role goes beyond campaign execution. As the business owner of your assigned ANT Europe Locales, you will translate business objectives into actionable operating plans, drive execution across Operation, BD, IBU (International Marketing), and cross-business-line teams, and continuously optimize site performance to achieve sustainable revenue growth. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to independently drive complex initiatives across Operation, Product, Train, Hotel, and Flight teams in a fast-paced international environment. In this Role, you’ll get to: Own commercial performance across key European markets, particularly the UK, Italy, Spain and France, with accountability for GMV, traffic, conversion and margin. Build alignment and influence priorities across Business Development, Marketing, Product, Operations and other Trip.com teams, securing the cross-functional support needed to achieve commercial goals. Translate regional objectives into focused market plans with clear priorities and measurable outcomes. Use customer, competitor and performance insights to identify growth opportunities and operational bottlenecks. Lead seasonal promotions, major sales moments and Attractions & Tours campaigns across the Trip.com app and website. Coordinate on-site merchandising, search visibility, push notifications, email and other marketing channels. Manage campaigns end to end, from commercial planning and product readiness through to launch, analysis and optimisation. Partner with Business Development teams to define sourcing priorities based on customer demand, market trends and commercial potential. Improve product assortment, pricing, availability and merchandising across priority destinations. Identify supply and inventory gaps that could limit customer choice or commercial growth. Develop opportunities to cross-sell Attractions & Tours to customers booking flights, hotels and rail. Align Business Development, Marketing, Operations and other Trip.com teams around shared commercial priorities. Establish clear plans, timelines, ownership and success measures for cross-functional initiatives. Monitor performance through dashboards and regular business reviews, translating data into practical recommendations. Track competitor activity, customer behaviour and market trends to identify new growth opportunities. Continuously improve operating processes and remove barriers to effective execution. What you'll Need to Succeed: 4+ years of experience in commercial operations, marketplace operations, category management, e-commerce, growth, revenue management or digital marketing. Experience owning commercial KPIs such as GMV, revenue, conversion, traffic or margin. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into clear commercial actions. Experience delivering multi-market campaigns or initiatives across several functions. Good understanding of e-commerce merchandising, pricing, customer journeys and digital marketing channels. Strong project management, prioritisation and stakeholder influencing skills. Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, international environment. Experience within an OTA, tours and activities marketplace, attraction, ticketing platform or consumer marketplace would be beneficial. Experience with CMS, merchandising, campaign management or analytics tools would be an advantage. Fluent English; French, Spanish, Italian or German would be advantageous. Why Trip.com Group As a world leading company in travel industry, we provide a platform for our talent to unleash their power, make a global impact, and achieve a successful career. As an international team, we're dedicated to create a space where open communication and mutual respect is encouraged. At Trip.com Group, we are here to support you in and out of the workplace, enabling you to explore and embrace more possibilities and pursue a dream life. What’s more? A fast-growing enviroment that offers strong potential for career growth and encourages bold ideas. We focus on cutting-edge technology to provide some of the best platforms and resources for you to do your best work. We encourage internal talent movement and provide global opportunities across functions, business units or regions for you to accelerate your career advancement. Thrive in a talented, supportive team with genuine, rigorous, and focused individuals who can inspire you from day one. Enjoy flexible working arrangement and various engagements outside of work that make your life at Trip.com Group Fulfilling. Click the link to learn more about “What Makes Trip.com Group a Leading Global Travel Service Provider?” Click the link to learn more about “This Is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!” Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com. Have a good trip, and see you soon!

description: Stellenbeschreibung Du möchtest die digitale Zukunft von Bund, Ländern und Kommunen aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Bei CGI arbeiten wir in interdisziplinären und agilen Teams an anspruchsvollen Digitalisierungsprojekten für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir moderne IT-Lösungen und unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, Prozesse effizienter, digitaler und nutzerfreundlicher zu gestalten. Dabei verfolgen wir ein gemeinsames Ziel: Wir möchten das Leben für Bürger:innen und Beschäftigte der öffentlichen Verwaltung einfacher machen. Zur Verstärkung unserer Teams suchen wir IT Business Analysten (m/w/d) für unsere Standorte Berlin, Bonn, Köln und Düsseldorf. Aufgaben Du analysierst fachliche und technische Anforderungen unserer Kunden und bildest die Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT. Du erhebst, strukturierst und dokumentierst Anforderungen und übersetzt fachliche Bedarfe in konkrete Anforderungen und Umsetzungskonzepte für IT-Lösungen. Du arbeitest eng mit Product Ownern, Projektleitungen, Entwicklungsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst für eine strukturierte Kommunikation zwischen den Beteiligten. Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer digitalen Lösungen und bringst eigene Ideen zur Prozessoptimierung und Digitalisierung ein. Qualifikation Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Verwaltungswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Du bringst ca. 2–5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung mit. Idealerweise hast du bereits in IT- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten im Public Sector bzw. in der öffentlichen Verwaltung gearbeitet. Du hast Erfahrung in der Analyse, Strukturierung und Dokumentation fachlicher und/oder technischer Anforderungen. Der Umgang mit gängigen Tools und Methoden im Requirements Engineering ist dir vertraut. Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen und überzeugst durch ein sicheres und kommunikatives Auftreten. Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1). Wir bieten dir: Bei CGI stehen unsere Mitarbeiter ganz vorne: durch unseren Share Purchase Plan (Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst Du in CGI-Aktien investieren) sind unsere Mitarbeiter Teilhaber am Erfolg unseres Unternehmen, daher werden sie auch Member genannt. Als CGI Member hat man zusätzlich diese Vorteile: Bei uns findest du Kolleg*innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Dank unseres „Metro Market“-Modells kannst du meist dort arbeiten, wo du lebst. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Wir bieten verschiedene Modelle, damit du mobil sein kannst: z. B. Bahncard, Dienstfahrrad oder Firmenwagen. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Wir unterstützen dich, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite. Eine Vielzahl an Events und Freizeitaktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren. Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

Own key growth metrics including traffic, conversion, customer acquisition, activation, repeat purchase, retention, ARPU and revenue. Identify new growth opportunities across markets, customer segments, destinations and distribution channels. Optimise CAC, ROAS, conversion rate and customer lifetime value (LTV). Identify the most effective acquisition channels by market and customer segment. Lead A/B testing and experimentation across landing pages, pricing, checkout, promotions, onboarding and product messaging. Work closely with Product and Technology teams to improve conversion and customer experience. Use behavioural and funnel analytics to identify drop-off points and growth opportunities. Pricing & Proposition Analyse competitor pricing, bundles and propositions across international eSIM markets. Support development of country, regional and global eSIM packages. Test pricing, promotional offers, bundles and incentives to improve conversion and profitability. Develop propositions for different customer segments including leisure travellers, business travellers, frequent travellers and international communities. CRM, Retention & Customer Lifetime Value Develop strategies to increase repeat purchase and customer lifetime value. Work with CRM teams on email, push notifications, in-app messaging and personalised customer journeys. Develop segmentation and lifecycle campaigns based on destinations, travel behaviour, purchase history and usage. Drive cross-sell, upsell, recharge and repeat-travel campaigns. Identify priority countries and destinations based on demand, profitability and competitive opportunity. Work with local and central teams to execute market launches and growth initiatives.

description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About The Team The Marketing team at Airwallex drives brand awareness and customer engagement through innovative and strategic campaigns. We work to communicate the value of our financial solutions, attract new customers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones. By leveraging data-driven insights and creative strategies, we ensure Airwallex stands out in a competitive market. Our team is passionate about telling the Airwallex story and supporting the company’s growth and success. What You’ll Do Most strategy roles hand you a slide deck. This one hands you the keys. You'll get the kind of access most people wait a decade for: a direct line to the growth engine, work that spans every function, and the freedom to own ambiguous, high-stakes problems end to end. And you won't do it the old way. We arm our people with AI to move faster than teams ten times our size, modeling, researching, and shipping at a pace that creates an unfair advantage. If you want to do the best work of your career on problems that actually matter, build with us. How you'll make impact Own the lifecycle growth strategy for Airwallex’s self-serve small-business customers, helping them move from onboarding and KYC through activation, first transaction and deeper product adoption. You’ll turn customer, product and behavioural data into practical growth opportunities, then design and run evergreen campaigns, experiments, automations and AI-enabled workflows that improve conversion, go-live activation and expansion across products without dedicated sales coverage. Lead Lifecycle Strategy: Design the end-to-end lifecycle engagement and build scalable lifecycle journeys for self-serve customers in EMEA and products without dedicated sales coverage. Own Digital Channels for Self-Serve: Lead the strategy and operational health for email, push, and in-app messaging. Ensure these high-impact channels are optimized to deliver personalized engagement and consistent growth across managed regions. Drive End-to-End Campaign Execution: Transform high-level lifecycle strategies into high-performing programs. Design and optimise evergreen campaigns, experiments and automations that improve conversion, go-live activation and expansion. Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Data and regional teams to turn customer, product and behavioural data into measurable growth opportunities Regional Funnel Accountability: Take full ownership of E2E growth metrics within your region. Leverage deep-dive quantitative analysis to identify high-impact opportunities for experimentation, ensuring data-driven decision-making at every touchpoint. Drive Regional Experimentation: Initiate and lead a high-velocity experimentation roadmap within your region, testing innovative tactics to uncover local growth levers and scale successful pilots into global frameworks. User-Centric Communication: Champion a "customer-first" messaging philosophy, delivering personalized and compelling content that resonates with users and reduces friction throughout the lifecycle. Who You Are We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of experience leading growth initiatives across the customer lifecycle. Experience in a product-led growth (PLG) environment, with a strong customer-first and customer-centric mindset. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign, product and behavioural data, identify trends, prioritize campaign ideas and develop data-backed recommendations. Experience working with high volumes of data and communicating clearly through data and analytics. Hands-on experience designing and executing lifecycle or CRM programmes that drive customer conversion, activation, retention and product adoption. Experience running A/B tests and applying structured experimentation to improve performance. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Clear and structured communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners, especially across Sales, Marketing and Data Science. A proactive and results-oriented approach, with a track record of getting things done and delivering impact in fast-paced environments. Bachelor’s degree. Preferred Qualifications Experience in B2B, SaaS, fintech or product-led growth; high-scale B2C experience will also be considered. Experience with AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automation or connecting multiple tools to improve execution. Experience with SQL or close collaboration with data teams. Hands-on experience in lifecycle or CRM marketing. Experience working across global markets and turning regional initiatives into scalable global programmes. You'll thrive here if You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. You default to action. You'd rather course-correct in motion than wait for perfect clarity. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

description: Overview This is more than a job. It’s a chance to build, grow, and make a real impact! Join our team as our new Product Owner, Amplify Fusion. As a Product Owner for the Amplify Platform at Axway, you will help translate product strategy into clear, prioritized execution for one or more platform capabilities. Working closely with Product Line leadership, Product Managers, Product Owners, R&D, UX, Support, Sales, and customer-facing teams, you will ensure development teams have a well-understood backlog that reflects customer needs, business priorities, and the overall platform vision. You will own day-to-day backlog definition and refinement for assigned product areas, ensuring work is precise, valuable, feasible , and aligned with roadmap priorities. We are looking for a pragmatic, detail-oriented business technologist with a strong affinity for API management, integration, platform services, SaaS, and enterprise customer problems. The ideal candidate champions whole-solution thinking, balancing functional requirements with scalability, reliability, security, usability, operability, and commercial considerations. You will represent the voice of customers and internal stakeholders in delivery discussions, helping convert market needs, roadmap themes, and technical constraints into actionable user stories and measurable outcomes. Responsibilities Backlog Ownership : Create, refine, and maintain a prioritized backlog for assigned platform capabilities, ensuring that epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and dependencies are clear and ready for execution. Roadmap Execution : Translate roadmap direction from Product Line leadership and Product Management into actionable delivery plans, balancing business value, customer impact, technical feasibility, and delivery capacity. Requirements Definition : Work with customers, stakeholders, UX, architects, and engineering teams to clarify problems, define outcomes, document requirements, and validate that delivered capabilities solve real customer needs. Agile Delivery Partnership : Partner with Scrum Masters, Engineering Managers, architects, and development teams to support sprint planning, backlog grooming, dependency management, demos, and release readiness. Prioritization : Make data-informed prioritization recommendations and trade-offs based on customer value, strategic alignment, risk reduction, technical debt, regulatory or security needs, and commercial opportunity. Stakeholder Communication : Communicate plans, progress, risks, and decisions clearly to Product Line leadership, R&D, Support, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders. Customer and Field Input : Capture, structure, and synthesize customer, field, support, and competitive input so that recurring needs and pain points are visible in planning and backlog decisions. Release Enablement : Support release planning, internal enablement, documentation readiness, launch preparation, and handover activities for new or enhanced platform capabilities. Quality and Adoption Focus : Monitor adoption, feedback, defects, support trends, and operational signals to identify improvement opportunities and help ensure capabilities are robust, usable, and valuable. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Business, Management Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Solution Consultant, or similar role in enterprise software. Experience working in a SaaS, platform, API management, integration middleware, iPaaS, or comparable enterprise technology environment. Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, user-story writing, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, and release coordination. Ability to turn complex customer, business, and technical needs into clear requirements that development teams can understand and execute. Comfortable working with ambiguity, competing priorities, and distributed teams across multiple time zones. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Experience with product management and development tools such as Jira, Aha!, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms. Approximately 10% travel may be required , including international travel. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with API management, application integration, developer experience, platform services, cloud-native delivery, or enterprise integration products. Familiarity with non-functional requirements such as scalability, resiliency, observability, security, compliance, usability, and operational supportability. Experience contributing to product launches, internal enablement, customer advisory sessions, UX research, or field-feedback programs. Prior exposure to AI-enabled product capabilities or data-driven product decision-making is a plus. If you are a product-minded, execution-oriented Product Owner who wants to help shape scalable platform capabilities for enterprise customers, we encourage you to apply. Company Overview Axway has been shaping the future of enterprise integration for over 25 years. We are recognized as global industry leaders, helping organizations drive digital transformation with secure, mission-critical software that powers impactful business outcomes. As part of 74Software , we're backed by a group of leading software companies delivering mission-critical solutions worldwide. Our focus is on delivering long-term value, leveraging cutting-edge technology, and fostering strong client partnerships. Join us and be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team shaping the future of enterprise integration solutions. Why Axway? At Axway, we believe we're better together. We celebrate diverse perspectives and experiences, knowing our people are our greatest strength. Join us and be part of a team where you can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We offer benefits that support your health, growth, and lifestyle, so you can thrive at work and beyond, including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, flexible work, career development, competitive pay, and global culture perks. Equal Opportunity Employer We are committed to providing equal opportunities and ensuring a fair and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, race, religion, or any other protected characteristic.

description: As our E-commerce Manager, you'll lead the growth of Vynevo's global direct-to-consumer ecosystem across our portfolio of next-generation beauty, wellness and personal care brands. You'll own our D2C strategy from acquisition to retention, creating seamless digital experiences that accelerate international growth and strengthen long-term customer relationships. Working closely with our marketing, studio, operations and technology teams, you'll optimize every stage of the customer journey while leveraging best-in-class e-commerce platforms, CRM, analytics and automation tools to scale our global business. We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, highly analytical, commercially driven and passionate about building premium consumer brands through data-led decision making. Key responsibilities Lead the global e-commerce strategy across Vynevo's portfolio of beauty, wellness and personal care brands. Develop and execute initiatives to accelerate D2C revenue through customer acquisition, retention, loyalty and subscription growth. Build and optimize high-performing customer journeys across web, mobile and CRM touchpoints. Collaborate with our Studio team on engaging content strategies supporting campaigns, launches and seasonal activations. Partner closely with Marketing to ensure consistent storytelling and seamless omnichannel customer experiences. Monitor and report on key commercial performance metrics, translating insights into actionable growth initiatives. Analyze customer behaviour, market trends and competitor activity to identify new commercial opportunities. Develop commercial growth plans for each brand and international market. Optimize subscription performance, customer lifetime value (LTV) and repeat purchase rates. Own e-commerce analytics including traffic, conversion, average order value (AOV), retention, subscription metrics and LTV. Leverage CRM, loyalty and personalization platforms to increase engagement and retention. Collaborate with Finance on forecasting, budgeting, promotional planning and commercial performance. Partner with Operations to forecast demand and optimize D2C inventory planning. What we're looking for 5+ years in e-commerce, digital commerce or digital marketing, preferably within premium consumer brands (beauty, wellness, lifestyle or FMCG). Proven experience growing online revenue across paid, owned and organic channels. Strong understanding of e-commerce KPIs including conversion, CAC, ROAS, AOV, LTV and retention. Experience managing subscription-based or recurring revenue business models is highly desirable. Highly analytical with strong commercial acumen and a data-driven decision-making mindset. Entrepreneurial, proactive and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-growing international business. Excellent project management and organizational skills, able to manage multiple priorities. Strong knowledge of CRM, customer lifecycle marketing, personalization and loyalty strategies. Solid understanding of SEO, SEM, merchandising and digital customer experience optimization. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a hands-on, results-oriented mindset. A passion for beauty, consumer brands, innovation and building exceptional digital experiences. What we offer A high-impact role helping shape one of the industry's most ambitious next-generation beauty companies. The opportunity to build and scale globally recognized beauty, wellness and personal care brands. A creative, entrepreneurial and international working environment. Significant ownership, autonomy and the ability to make a measurable commercial impact. Endless opportunities for rapid professional development and career growth. Exposure to global markets and international expansion initiatives. Collaboration with leading technology, retail and industry partners. A competitive salary and benefits package.

description: We have a demand generation and expansion engine that’s already running. What we need now is someone who can design the campaign strategies behind it, make the commercial trade-off decisions that determine where we invest, and take ownership of the outcomes across the full customer lifecycle. This is a strategic digital marketing role for someone who doesn’t just run campaigns — you design them. You decide what we run, why we run it, where we spend, and what we stop doing. You will own the strategic planning and optimization of global digital campaigns — from paid media and nurture programs to ABM plays and customer expansion campaigns — making the calls on channel mix, audience strategy, and budget allocation that determine whether our marketing investment converts into pipeline and revenue. You will sit within the Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, and working closely with Digital Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Content and Creative. This role strengthens the strategic engine of our demand generation and expansion motion — you’re the person who decides what campaigns we build, how we structure them, and where we make trade-offs to maximize commercial impact across acquisition and growth. If you’re a digital strategist who designs campaign architectures rather than just executing them, makes data-informed trade-off decisions with confidence, understands that marketing’s job doesn’t stop at the closed deal, and wants to be a key contributor in a high-performing growth team — this is your role. What you’ll work on Campaign strategy and design Design the strategic framework for global multi-channel digital campaigns — defining audience strategy, channel mix, sequencing, and budget allocation across paid search, paid social, display, email, and content syndication to hit pipeline and expansion targets Make commercial trade-off decisions on where to invest and where to pull back — you’re expected to analyze performance, identify diminishing returns, and reallocate spend and effort based on what’s actually driving outcomes Define campaign architectures across the full bow-tie — designing how campaigns work together from awareness and lead generation through to nurture, conversion, and customer expansion, not just launching them one at a time Brief the Content and Creative team on what’s needed and why — setting clear strategic direction for campaign assets based on audience insight, channel requirements, and commercial goals Account-based marketing strategy and execution Design and execute digital ABM campaign strategies targeting named accounts and account segments — defining the engagement model, channel approach, and success criteria in collaboration with the enterprise and sales teams Architect multi-touch ABM plays that blend paid media, personalized content, email sequences, and retargeting — making deliberate decisions about where to invest across new logo and expansion opportunities Stay current on the latest ABM tactics, platforms, and approaches — from intent data providers and programmatic ABM to personalization at scale — and make recommendations on what Duetto should adopt, test, or stop doing Define ABM measurement frameworks at the account level — tracking engagement, pipeline influence, and progression rather than just lead volume, and using those insights to reshape strategy Nurture, conversion, and expansion strategy Design and optimize nurture strategies across both acquisition and expansion — deciding what workflows we run, how they’re structured, and where we need to fix friction across the full bow-tie Define the campaign strategy for customer expansion — designing upsell, cross-sell, and adoption campaigns that support the commercial goals of the customer success and sales teams, not just repeating acquisition tactics Make data-informed decisions on where to focus conversion optimization effort — prioritizing the stages and segments where improvements will have the greatest commercial impact Own the analysis of campaign and channel performance — turning data into strategic recommendations on what to change, scale, or retire across the full lifecycle Regional strategy and localization Define how global campaign strategies should be adapted for local markets — making decisions on where to localize messaging, creative, and channel strategy versus where to maintain global consistency Provide strategic performance analysis by territory that helps regional teams and leadership understand what digital marketing is delivering — and what needs to change — across both demand generation and expansion MarTech and data operations Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the marketing technology stack — making recommendations on how to improve integration between campaign platforms, CRM, and lead routing systems Ensure campaign infrastructure supports the strategic ambitions of the growth team — you’re the person who sees where the tech is limiting execution and makes the case for fixing it Champion clean data practices and campaign hygiene — because the quality of strategic decisions depends on a database you can trust AI-first campaign operations Use AI as a core part of how you design, plan, and optimize campaign strategies — from audience research and competitive analysis to performance modeling and scenario planning Bring an AI-native mindset to campaign strategy — always asking how automation, smarter tooling, and agentic workflows can raise the quality and speed of strategic decision-making, not just execution Contribute to how the Growth Marketing team adopts AI in day-to-day work — testing new approaches, sharing what works, and helping build practices that make the whole team faster and sharper Treat AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut — the bar for strategic quality, targeting precision, and commercial impact stays high regardless of the tools used What we’re looking for Experience 5+ years in digital marketing, growth marketing, or marketing operations — with demonstrable experience designing campaign strategies that have driven measurable pipeline and expansion revenue, not just executing plans built by others Demonstrable experience designing and owning digital ABM campaign strategies — defining targeting, engagement models, and measurement frameworks for named accounts or account segments Proven ability to make commercial trade-off decisions across paid media, email, nurture, and content syndication — you know how to read performance data and decide where to invest, scale, or cut Experience designing marketing campaigns across both acquisition and customer expansion — you understand the bow-tie and know how to architect campaigns that drive growth on both sides of it Experience with marketing technology platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, and programmatic/ABM tools — you understand the strategic possibilities and limitations of the stack, not just how to operate it Background in B2B SaaS preferred — but strong strategic thinking and commercial instinct matter more than sector match Skills and capabilities Strong campaign strategist — you design campaign architectures, define audience and channel strategies, and make the decisions that shape what gets built and launched Data-informed decision maker — you don’t just report on performance, you interpret it, draw conclusions, and make strategic recommendations that change what the team does next Commercially minded — you understand that every campaign decision is a trade-off and you make those trade-offs with pipeline and revenue outcomes in mind Clear communicator — able to present strategic recommendations, brief creative teams with precision, and articulate the rationale behind campaign decisions to senior stakeholders Curious and proactive — you stay ahead of what’s changing in digital marketing and bring strategic recommendations to the team without being asked How you operate You think about campaigns in terms of pipeline contribution and expansion revenue, not just clicks and impressions You’re a strategist who ships — you design campaigns with commercial intent and then make sure they get executed at the standard you set You’re comfortable with complexity — balancing multiple campaign strategies across multiple channels, regions, and commercial objectives at the same time You understand the bow-tie — you see acquisition and expansion as two halves of the same commercial motion and design campaign strategies accordingly You embrace AI as part of how you work — using it to think faster and make better strategic decisions, not as a replacement for judgment What success looks like in year one Campaign strategies in place across acquisition and expansion that are clearly driving measurable pipeline contribution and revenue ABM campaign strategies running against named accounts with defined engagement models and account-level progression metrics — not just awareness impressions Nurture and expansion strategies optimized with measurable improvements in conversion rates across both sides of the bow-tie — based on trade-off decisions you made and can evidence Clean, strategic campaign reporting that gives leadership and regional teams confidence in where digital marketing is delivering and where investment should shift You are a key strategic contributor the Growth Marketing team relies on — trusted by the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, the wider growth SaaS business with customers across hotels, casinos, and hospitality groups worldwide.
